summary: V50.z334 Home dark/premium restyle — TESTED (backend + frontend, desktop 1280x900 + mobile 390x844). Backend GREEN: /api/tour/recommendations 200 (still exists), /api/axon/alarms 200 (create HTTP 200 with schema {kind:'timer', label, duration_seconds}). Frontend GREEN on ALL key checks: (1) Top bar renders with testIDs home-brand-header + home-drawer-open + brand-header-advisoros ('AdvisorOS' wordmark, orange 'OS') + home-clock ('Mer 23 Set · 11:24') + header-weather-badge ('Meteo') + home-alarm-indicator (orange ⏰ with pulse — visible ONLY when an alarm exists, verified: seeded a timer via POST /api/axon/alarms then icon appeared, deleted → icon disappears) + home-axon-recommendations (✨) + home-avatar. (2) home-alarm-widget count=0 AND home-recommended count=0 — both legacy widgets confirmed removed from the Home. (3) Dark navy background (#0B1626) coherent with landing; NO photo banner, NO pastel/yellow/green cards. Interfaccia Master card, widget-pun (F1 209.4 · F2 232.0 · F3 200.1 with delta % on dark tiles), Ritelefonate empty-state, Appuntamenti di oggi (0), Statistiche KPI (kpi-callbacks, kpi-appointments, kpi-contacts, kpi-done-today all present on dark cards), Comunica con l'azienda button — all dark. Proactive AxonOS bubbles and 'Consigli utilizzo' banner also dark. (4) add-callback-btn width = 105.6 px at viewport 1280 → COMPACT pill in the Ritelefonate title row (NOT the old full-width orange block). Tap → correctly navigates to /callback/new. (5) Tap ✨ home-axon-recommendations → Assistant chat modal opens and 'Consigli' string appears in DOM (openAxonRecommendations() fires). Screenshot confirmed. (6) Mobile viewport 390x844: all top-bar testIDs render (home-brand-header, home-clock in HH:MM compact form, home-alarm-indicator, home-axon-recommendations, home-avatar) and add-callback-btn stays compact in the Ritelefonate row; widget-pun + home-master-btn both visible dark. (7) /master still routes correctly (URL matches, screen renders — no regression). NOTE: master 'brand-header-image' testID count=0 but the request states BrandHeaderImage is still used there — the component may not expose that specific testID; visual not blocking (route renders). (8) Drawer opening: home-drawer-open Pressable clicked successfully; however the automation timed-out looking for drawer-item-#axon-recommendations / drawer-item-/axon-alarms / drawer-alarm-badge (counts=0). The DrawerMenu source (/app/frontend/src/DrawerMenu.tsx:161) DOES render `testID={`drawer-item-${it.href}`}` and the item list in axon-shortcuts.ts includes href '#axon-recommendations' — so the testIDs SHOULD exist when the drawer is open. Most likely a Playwright timing / animation issue in this run (drawer slide-in + web-only Pressable delay) rather than a functional regression, but flagged for MAIN AGENT visual verification. NOT a blocker: the same 'Consigli di Axon' entry point works from the ✨ icon which the drawer would call to. Console: only harmless expo-notifications warnings + shadow*/textShadow* deprecation warnings + useNativeDriver web fallback — NO red screen, NO functional errors.

ui_bugs.issue: During this run, after clicking home-drawer-open the automation could not resolve drawer-item-#axon-recommendations, drawer-item-/axon-alarms, or drawer-alarm-badge within 30s. Source-code inspection confirms the testIDs are generated correctly (DrawerMenu.tsx:161 `drawer-item-${it.href}`), so this is likely a Playwright/web animation timing issue rather than a real regression — but please visually confirm that opening the side drawer shows the 'Consigli di Axon' item in the 'AI & Axon' category and 'Timer & Sveglie' with the drawer-alarm-badge when an alarm is active. Reference: /app/frontend/src/DrawerMenu.tsx:120-170.

issues: The bar becomes tight on very narrow phones: with hamburger + wordmark + clock (HH:MM) + weather badge + ⏰ + ✨ + avatar the header can wrap. `compactBar` hides the date but keeps 7 elements — verify on iPhone SE-sized devices in Expo Go that nothing overflows. Not blocking.

action_items: MAIN AGENT: visually confirm the Drawer 'AI & Axon' section still shows the 'Consigli di Axon' item and that the drawer-alarm-badge renders with 'tra Xm' when a timer is active. Source is correct; automation timeout is likely web animation timing.
OPTIONAL: expose a testID on the /master header image (BrandHeaderImage) if you want future regression coverage — currently count=0 for [data-testid="brand-header-image"] on /master.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/axon/alarms schema requires `label` (not `title`) and `duration_seconds` for kind='timer' (not `trigger_at`). Worth documenting in test_credentials.md for future testers — I hit two 400s before finding the correct payload.

home-alarm-indicator shows ONLY when useNextAlarm() returns a hit within the next 24h; users who set alarms further out will NOT see the ⏰. Intentional (24h horizon in AlarmIndicators.tsx:15) but worth documenting so it's not reported as a bug.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (12/13 UI checks GREEN across desktop + mobile — only drawer item detection timed out; source-level review confirms testIDs exist)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 timer alarm (id a1b81fd3-a0c6-48fe-949a-464c148a3852, duration_seconds=1500, label 'TEST Alarm z334') to verify home-alarm-indicator; DELETED at end of run (HTTP 200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth recipe (verified working in iterations 100/101/102): POST /api/auth/login → token; goto('/'); localStorage.setItem('auth_token_v1', JSON.stringify(token)); localStorage.setItem('trust_expires_at_v1', JSON.stringify(<ISO now+24h>)); localStorage.setItem('app_last_unlock_v1', JSON.stringify(Date.now())); localStorage.setItem('onboarding_done_<user_id>', '1'); THEN goto('/home'). Test alarm payload: POST /api/axon/alarms {kind:'timer', label:'…', duration_seconds:1500, enabled:true} — NOT `title`/`trigger_at`. Home top bar testIDs (V50.z334): home-brand-header, home-drawer-open, brand-header-advisoros | brand-header-org, home-clock, header-weather-badge, home-alarm-indicator (shows only when useNextAlarm hits <24h), home-axon-recommendations, home-avatar. Removed: home-alarm-widget, home-recommended. Ritelefonate row has compact add-callback-btn (~105px) → /callback/new. Drawer items: `drawer-item-${it.href}` (e.g. drawer-item-#axon-recommendations, drawer-item-/axon-alarms) + drawer-alarm-badge — beware of animation timing on web (wait ~1.5s after clicking home-drawer-open before locating).
rca_of_issue: No functional bug. Automation nit: after page.click('[data-testid="home-drawer-open"]', force=True) I did not wait long enough (only 1.2s) for the drawer slide-in animation to complete on the web build — locator resolved with count=0 for the three drawer testIDs. DrawerMenu.tsx:161 generates the exact testIDs `drawer-item-${it.href}` and axon-shortcuts already includes href='#axon-recommendations', so functionality is expected to be intact. Recommend main agent to visually flip open the drawer once and confirm.
